description: This file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryDao class, a Data Access Object responsible for querying and aggregating employee-related actions and reviews within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for counting scheduled interviews, pending appraisals, and self-reviews, utilizing Doctrine query builders and specific filter parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryDao
classes.description: A DAO class for retrieving employee action summaries such as scheduled interviews, pending reviews, and self-reviews in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getActionableScheduledInterviewCount
methods.description: Counts the number of interviews scheduled for a set of candidate IDs.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewCount
methods.description: Counts pending performance appraisal reviews based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewCount
methods.description: Counts self-reviews that are pending for a specific employee, according to filter parameters.
